status: PROPOSAL from experiment E5 (2026-11-07). Not applied anywhere. Evidence: source/analysis/builder/process-v1/e5-gate-calibration.md/.json. Only 10 liked (4-5 stars) and 7 disliked (1-2 stars) boards carry tiles, so every change is low-power; confidence is stated per gate.
options: static_gates.js reads o.thresholds.A7 = {unrelieved, tightBlind, lostDeals}; traces.js reads opts.thresholds (key-by-key override of THRESHOLDS). Defaults unchanged.

A1.note: not judgeable on old boards (idle-special checks fail on 15 of 18 qualified boards built by an older process); judge on fresh builds only

A2.note: excluded from E5 by design (old boards are not readable)

A3.note: structural legality; failures on old boards are clock.n / peek-pair facts, not taste

A4.note: the test itself passes 9/10 liked and 7/7 disliked boards; the 'no shippable spare' failures on liked boards come from k+s > 19 (17 of 46 boards have k > 16), a clock-length cap, not from a hidden single order

A5.note: passes 4/10 liked, 6/7 disliked; the old boards were not built with priced detours, so E5 cannot calibrate it. Re-decide with E6 yield data

A6.note: passes 9/10 liked and 7/7 disliked; the one liked failure (225, one fork whose only win is not goal-directed under some deal) is a real finding to look at

A7.note: all three sub-checks reject the boards Dennis liked more than the ones he disliked (liked boards have MORE unrelieved luck moments). Log the three numbers on every board; do not reject on them. Optional soft cap for later: none supported by this data

B2.evidence: 0.50 passes 3/10 liked and 0/7 disliked; 0.20 passes 6/10 liked and 1/7 disliked. B2 is higher on liked than on disliked boards (medians 0.25 vs 0.08, AUC 0.69), so the E5 'report-only' trigger does not fire. Caveat: the forks here are engine-derived, not authored, so B2 is really tested only on fresh builds

B3.evidence: liked first-error medians run 0.09-0.32; 4 of 10 fall under 0.15. Does not separate liked from disliked (AUC 0.43); keep as a sanity window

B4.evidence: liked boards have delays up to 10 (blind1-185, blind1-194 'very hard but fun hard'); max 10 passes 10/10 liked, 6/7 disliked

B5.evidence: 0/10 liked boards fail; catches 2 of the 3 lateSqueeze boards; misses factory6-184 (0 late tray losses for the bot)

B6.evidence: 0.40 fails 225 (post-clock share 0.62, 5 stars, so the kill rule fires). 0.65 is fitted to that one board. Fall back to report-only if E6 shows it rejecting good boards

B7.note: unchanged; liked boards have the higher repeat share (AUC 0.80), so never gate on it
